topSignals.title: Bloom Energy 10-Q/A: $196.3M net income, $300M H1 operating cash flow, $2.69B cash — first cash-generative quarter
topSignals.text: — An amended quarterly report (10-Q/A) for the period ended June 30, 2026, filed in early August, provides the complete financial picture beyond the July 28 earnings release. Key new data: net income $196.3M (Bloom's first profitable quarter), H1 2026 operating cash flow $300M (vs. negative in prior periods), cash/equivalents $2.69B — the strongest balance-sheet position in company history. LCOE model implications: (a) Bloom is now self-financing capex from operations, compressing WACC toward 8.5–9.5%; (b) $2.69B cash enables Fremont 2 GW ramp completion without equity dilution; (c) Q2 gross margin 33.4% confirmed, in line with guidance. Action: extract shipped MW from SEC EDGAR filing to update revenue-per-kW inputs. SEC EDGAR 10-Q | StockTitan 10-Q summary

topSignals.title: FERC RM26-4: August 17 tariff-reform deadline in 12 days — abeyance decision imminent
topSignals.text: — All six RTOs/ISOs (PJM, MISO, CAISO, ISO-NE, NYISO, SPP) submitted abeyance requests by the August 3 deadline. FERC has not yet published its response as of August 5. If FERC denies any abeyance: the August 17 hard tariff-reform deadline activates, requiring RTOs/ISOs to file tariff revisions or show cause. If granted (90-day maximum): November 16 stakeholder filing deadline. Either outcome codifies or defers the $5–20/MWh avoided-transmission-cost benefit for on-site SOFC projects across PJM/MISO/CAISO/ISO-NE/NYISO/SPP regions. LCOE model update triggered by FERC response; no change today. FERC RM26-4 docket | McGuireWoods

topSignals.title: Rolls-Royce SMR GDA Step 3 reaches August 2026 decision point — UK Wylfa construction timeline crystallizes
topSignals.text: — The UK's Generic Design Assessment (GDA) Step 3 for Rolls-Royce's 470 MWe SMR design is due for completion in August 2026 (with some sources indicating a possible slip to December 2026). GDA completion is a prerequisite for construction licensing at the three-unit, 1,400 MW Wylfa Anglesey site under the Rolls-Royce SMR / Great British Energy-Nuclear (GBE-N) contract (signed April 2026). First power target: mid-2030s. European nuclear competitive signal: even the UK's most advanced SMR project cannot supply power before ~2033–2035, confirming SOFCs as the only commercially available firm on-site power option in the UK and European data center market through at least 2032. World Nuclear News | Rolls-Royce SMR | Neutron Bytes

items.text: Elcogen (priority): Quiet day August 5. Status unchanged from August 3: E3000 G2 EFCF 2026 paper on ResearchGate — >75% FC electrical efficiency (stack-level LHV), 90% total with heat recovery, 23,000 rapid current cycles with performance improvement in SOEC mode, zero thermal-cycling degradation. ELCO I Tallinn factory (360 MW/yr) in production and delivering G2 stacks. Next watch: full peer-reviewed paper and system-level efficiency confirmation at ELCO I production scale; boundary definition (stack-only LHV vs. net system electrical) critical before LCOE update. Elcogen product page

Rolls-Royce SMR GDA Step 3 (UK, August/December 2026 completion target) — See Top Signal #3. GDA Step 3 completion allows Wylfa construction licensing to proceed; first power mid-2030s. UK SOFC market confirmation: no nuclear competition before 2033 in the UK data center power segment. World Nuclear News

Amended 10-Q/A (see Top Signal #1) confirms record profitability. Scandium class action lead plaintiff deadline: September 28, 2026. Q3 2026 earnings (October) is the next fundamental catalyst. Ceres Power (LON: CWR): Quiet. ~−40% from June peak. First royalties received from licensees; H1 2026 results (September) next catalyst. Ceres newsroom

SOFC carbon-deposition risk maps with anode off-gas recirculation (Cell Reports Physical Science, Feb 5, 2026) — "Chemical activity-based carbon-deposition risk maps for solid oxide fuel cell systems with off-gas recirculation" presents a normalized-chemical-activity methodology for quantifying carbon-formation risk in SOFC systems using AOGR (anode off-gas recirculation). Key finding: higher AOGR ratios reduce the need for external steam generation but increase fuel dilution and coking risk — a system-level trade-off requiring map-based optimization. 2D and 3D risk maps are provided for all C-H-O gas mixtures, making the tool system-agnostic and applicable to natural-gas SOFCs as deployed by Bloom and Elcogen. More accurate than conventional steam-to-carbon or oxygen-to-carbon metrics. Cell Reports Physical Science00012-3) | ResearchGate

SOFC lifecycle assessment, technology barriers, and environmental impact (RSER Vol. 228, 2026) — "The technological development trends, barriers, and environmental impact assessment of solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) from a life cycle perspective," Renewable and Sustainable Energy Reviews Vol. 228, 2026. Comprehensive synthesis covering technology readiness, commercialization barriers (high stack cost, incomplete LCI data for O&M and end-of-life phases, methodological variability in published LCA studies), and environmental impact across feedstock types. Key finding: published LCA results may understate true lifecycle costs by 10–20% due to LCI data gaps, particularly in stack replacement logistics and material recovery. Calls for standardized research frameworks. LCOE flag: recommend adding a lifecycle cost uplift sensitivity of +10–15% to base-case LCOE for full-system NPV comparison. RSER / IDEAS

SOFC carbon-deposition risk maps (Cell Reports Physical Science, 2026) — See Research & IP above. System-scope: SOFC stack model with AOGR. Actionable for BOP design optimization — quantifying carbon risk enables right-sizing of reformer and steam generation infrastructure, potentially reducing BOP capital cost in natural-gas SOFC plants. LCOE flag. Cell Reports Physical Science00012-3)

lcoe.text: Bloom 10-Q/A (early August 2026): Net income $196.3M + H1 operating cash flow $300M + cash $2.69B. Bloom is now self-financing at scale: (a) WACC sensitivity band: revise toward 8.5–9.5% if BE holds above $220 through week-end; (b) Q2 gross margin 33.4% confirmed — on guidance; (c) strong balance sheet ($2.69B cash) accelerates Fremont 2 GW ramp, keeping 2027 capex bend trajectory on track. Action: extract shipped MW from SEC EDGAR 10-Q to update revenue-per-kW model input. SEC EDGAR

RSER LCA: 10–20% LCOE underestimation risk from LCI data gaps. Published LCOE studies may understate true 20-year system costs due to incomplete lifecycle inventory data in the operation, maintenance, and end-of-life phases. Recommend adding a "lifecycle cost uplift" sensitivity of +10–15% to base-case LCOE for full-NPV comparison against grid alternatives. RSER Vol. 228
FERC RM26-4: Hold $5–20/MWh avoided-T-cost as conditional LCOE input. Update immediately upon FERC abeyance decision publication (expected before August 17).
